summary: FG Nexus Inc. filed an Item 7.01/8.01 Form 8-K and press release reporting continued progress under previously authorized common and preferred stock repurchase programs. As of Sept. 14, 2026, buybacks had retired about 4.0 million common shares, roughly 46% of shares outstanding, leaving 4,707,615 common shares and 619,357 Series A Preferred shares. No per-share price, premium, advisor, or expiration is disclosed. The mechanics reflect aggressive shrinkage of the public float, which can amplify volatility and tighten ownership; watch execution pace, remaining authorization capacity, liquidity, and any Nasdaq float or listing implications.
